hardwareUnits.label: Nintendo Switch hardware units sold
hardwareUnits.definition: Nintendo Switch hardware sales units (all models) by region, published in units of ten thousand and converted to units (shown in the bracketed note).

softwareUnits.label: Nintendo Switch software units sold
softwareUnits.definition: Nintendo Switch software sales units by region, packaged and downloadable versions of packaged software, including units bundled with hardware; excludes download-only software and add-on content. Published in ten-thousands, converted to units.

notes: Unit sales by region (Japan, The Americas, Europe, Other) come from Nintendo's FY2025 Financial Results Explanatory Material; Nintendo Switch 2 had no FY2025 sales (launched June 2025). The regions are Nintendo's own and are not defined by country. PP&E by country (annual report): Japan ¥76,142M, U.S. ¥27,179M, Other ¥9,290M; only the U.S. is recorded as a row because the Japan row carries unit sales from a different document. Employees: 8,205 group-wide; the annual report gives employees only for the parent (2,962) and by major facility (HQ 2,647, Uji Plant 141, Tokyo Branch 174, Nintendo of America 1,446, Nintendo of Europe 1,124), shown in sites. Revenue by geography is already in the records and not repeated. Hosted on nintendo.co.jp (company), the English version of the annual securities report.
